verdict.rationale: Salv's API lets an external system update alert status and create or update manual alerts. Its webhooks push events such as new alerts and risk-level changes out to a client application, giving a documented two-way path for alert decisions. However, nothing in the evidence shows API or webhook access to Cases (investigations, notes, documents, assignees) or a packaged connector to another case-management system. Missing for 10: case/investigation-level API or sync, webhook events for alert decisions or case changes, documented bidirectional case-management integration, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can synchronize investigations and decisions with another case-management system

citations.quote: Alerts: Update alert status. Manual Alerts: Create manual alert, Update manual alert
Configuring a webhook will cause Salv to notify client application about a particular event, for example about a creation of a new alert or change of a risk level for any person.
